title: FailureSensorIQ: A Multi-Choice QA Dataset for Understanding Sensor Relationships and Failure Modes

bias_targets.methodology: Modifying multiple-choice questions by reordering options and changing option labels (e.g., A, B, C to P, Q, R) to evaluate if models rely on positional or label biases rather than actual reasoning.

Analyzing the correlation between a model's performance on specific industrial assets and the volume of documents available for those assets in external knowledge sources (e.g., Wikipedia, arXiv, CrossRef) to measure bias stemming from skewed training data representation.
